title: Trigger root-cause attribution contradicts the frozen pinned definition (drop-first, drop's bundle vs slot-order scan)
detail: The pinned definition selects the first saturated bundle in slot order with the settled scan (a) first; the code evaluates the drop (b) first and names the drop's own bundle, which may differ from the first at-bound bundle. The change log records the deviation but the frozen block was never amended.
recommended_fix: Amend the frozen Trigger-contract block to the implemented drop-first attribution, or restore slot-order selection in crisis_evaluate so the pinned definition holds.

title: Monotonicity latch rejects only backward ticks; equal ticks pass despite the 'strictly monotonic' claim
detail: A repeated tick (tick == state.tick) passes the latch and could re-apply that tick's action-log commands and duplicate events, silently corrupting the tick-ordered buffer the crisis scans depend on. The check enforces a weaker invariant than the comment claims.
recommended_fix: Reject tick <= state.tick, or explicitly document and gate the equal-tick path if any caller legitimately re-steps.

title: Cooldown-blocked drop branch skips the settled-scan and pool backstop for that set-piece
detail: When the drop's bundle is cooldown-blocked, the set-piece loop continues past the settled scan and the pool backstop for that tick — a different-bundle saturation (a different root cause) goes unnamed until the drop bundle's cooldown expires. Only reachable with cooldown > 0.
recommended_fix: On a cooldown block in the drop branch, fall through to the settled scan and pool backstop instead of continuing.

title: Pool-exhaustion test comment says the fix lands at tick 1501; the code draws it at 1500
detail: In a tick-exact golden discipline, a wrong tick in the fixture documentation invites re-derivation errors; the pinned stream (resolve @3000) rides the 1500 draws, not 1501. Comment and code disagree within the same test.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to "tick 1500", or move the draws to 1501 and re-pin the stream from the sim.

title: catalogs_load hard-fails on empty src.crises; every Catalog_Sources construction site must now supply crises bytes
evidence:
v, e := json.parse(src.crises, parse_integers = true)
		if e != nil { return {"crises.json", "$", "invalid JSON"} }
detail: There is no empty/missing-source guard — callers that leave src.crises nil now get a hard load rejection. The app loader and catalog_test helpers were updated here; any other constructor (e.g., the harness loader, outside this chunk) must be updated too or every load fails.
recommended_fix: Audit every Catalog_Sources construction site (harness loader included) for the new required crises field; consider an explicit named rejection for missing sources.
